message: How do I reset my password?

knowledge_base.title: Reset your password
knowledge_base.answer: For the fictional Acorn Desk service, choose Forgot password on the sign-in screen, enter your registered email address, and follow the reset link. Never share your password or reset link with support.

knowledge_base.title: Returning a purchase
knowledge_base.answer: For this synthetic store, unopened purchases can be returned within 30 days. Contact the store's support channel with the order reference to request return instructions. A refund is not guaranteed until the return is reviewed.
